name: ignite-vscode
description: Run Ignite's compliance/security pipeline against the open workspace folder — findings in the Problems panel, no separate web UI required.

ignite.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of a running Ignite server (`ignite-server`). Easiest to change from the **Overview** panel in the Ignite sidebar, which also tests the connection. Matches `IGNITE_BASE_URL`.

ignite.runLocalCi.description: Run Phase 5 org governance CI (act + Docker) as part of a scan. Off by default in the extension — it's the slowest phase and needs Docker.

ignite.showOverriddenIssues.description: Show issues already acknowledged in .ignite/acknowledgments.md as dimmed diagnostics instead of hiding them.

ignite.apiKey.markdownDescription:
**Prefer the Overview panel's API key field** — it stores the key in your OS keychain instead of plaintext settings; a keychain key wins over this setting.

Optional `ignite_...` API key (mint one with `create-api-key <email>` on the server), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. Needed for **Generate Fix PR** to open the PR under your own connected GitHub account.

enumDescriptions: Send the folder's path to a server on this machine (localhost); upload the folder to any other server.
Always send the path (validate-all). Only works when the server can read this machine's disk.
Always upload the folder's files as a simulation run (POST /api/pipeline, dryRun).
ignite.scanMode.markdownDescription: How scans reach the server. A remote server can't read your local disk, so `auto` uploads the folder (respecting `.gitignore`) unless the server is on `localhost`. Unauthenticated uploads need `security.allowUnauthenticatedInteractiveDryRun` on the server; path scans need `security.allowUnauthenticatedValidateAll`.
